summary.name: Python Weekly
summary.one_liner: Python Weekly is a newsletter that curates news, articles, new releases, tools, libraries and events related to Python.
use_cases: Keeping up with Python news each week
Finding new Python libraries and tools
summary.what_it_does: The page is the archive index for the Python Weekly newsletter, written by Rahul Chaudhary. It lists issues by number and date, from Issue 757 (August 6, 2026) to Issue 768 (October 22, 2026), with paginated access to older issues. According to the page description, each issue is hand-curated and covers news, articles, new releases, tools and libraries, and events related to Python. The page text does not show the contents of individual issues.
notable: Hand-curated weekly selection of Python news and resources
Archive of numbered issues, with the latest at Issue 768
caveats: Page text does not state whether the newsletter is free or paid
Page text does not describe the contents of individual issues
